articles.text: NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Wáng Lǎo Shīfu, nín xiūxi yìhuǐr ba. Wǒ zài zhèr kānzhe, nín bié dānxīn, wǒ bú huì shuì jiàode.
YOUNGER MAN: Old Master Wáng, you rest a while. I'll watch things here, don't worry. I won't fall asleep.
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Ōu, wǒ bú lèi, zánmen liǎ liáoliao tiānr ba!
OLD MASTER WÁNG: I'm not tired. Let's us two have a chat!
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Wáng Lǎo Shīfu, wǒ tīngshuō, nín jiěfàng qián jiu cānjiā gémìng le, nínde gùshi yídìng bù shǎo, gěi wo jiǎngjiang ba!
YOUNGER MAN: Old Master Wáng, I've heard that you joined the revolutionary ranks before liberation. You must have a lot of stories; tell me one!
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Nǐ zhīdao, jiěfàng qián wǒ shi zuò xiǎo mǎimaide, nèi shíhou zuò xiǎo mǎimai duō nán! Néng bu néng zhuàn yìdiǎnr qián dōu yào kàn yùnqi hǎo huài.

OLD MASTER WÁNG: You know, before liberation I was in small business. At that time, it was so hard to do small business. Whether or not you could make a little money depended on whether your luck was good or bad.
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Hòulái ne?
YOUNGER MAN: And later?
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Hòulái Rìběn rén lái le, Rìběn rén gēn zánmen dǎ zhàng, zhèi yíxiàzi wǒde mǎimai...
OLD MASTER WÁNG: Later the Japanese came. After the Japanese went to war with us, my business...
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Zuòbuxiàqu le.
YOUNGER MAN: You couldn't carry it on.
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Bú shì, wǒde mǎimai yuè zuò yuè dà le.
OLD MASTER WÁNG: No, it got bigger and bigger.
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Zěnme ne?
YOUNGER MAN: How was that?
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Nǐ xuéguo lìshǐ.
OLD MASTER WÁNG: You've studied history.
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Nǐ zhīdao nèi shíhou Zhū Lǎozǒng gēn Rìběn rén dǎle yízhàng...
OLD MASTER WÁNG: You know that at that time Zhū Lǎozǒng (Zhū Dé) fought with the Japanese...
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Zhīdao, nèi yízhàng dǎle hǎojǐge yuè. Nèi shíhou nín gàn shénme ne?
YOUNGER MAN: Yes, they fought for many months. What were you doing at that time?
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Wǒ? Wǒ yìtiān dào wǎn názhe dānzi gěi Zhū Lǎozǒngde jūnduì mǎi dōngxi ya! Shénme chīde, chuānde, yào a, wǒ dōu néng mǎidào.
OLD MASTER WÁNG: Me? From morning to night I was carrying a list buying things for Zhū Dé's army. Food, clothes, medicine, I could buy them all.
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Èi, zhēn yǒu yìsi, nín zài gěi wo jiǎngjiang.
YOUNGER MAN: Gee, that's fascinating, tell me more.
WÁNG LǍO SHĪFU: Ōu, xiànzài bù néng jiǎng le. Zánmen gāi chūqu kànkan le. Yàoshi méiyou shénme wèntí, huílai wǒ zài gěi ni jiǎng.
OLD MASTER WÁNG: I can't now. It's time we went out and took a look. If there aren't any problems, I'll tell you more after we get back.
NIÁNQĪNG RÉN: Nà zánmen zǒu ba!
YOUNGER MAN: Then let's go!
